notes: Manufacturer tech sheet (Jabra Speak2 55 Tech Sheet, 17052023, RevC) confirms the device's only physical wired I/O is a single non-removable ~80cm cable ending in a USB-C plug with an attached USB-A adapter on the same cable ("USB C or USB A" connectivity) — used interchangeably for host connectivity and charging; there is no separate charging port, no analog audio jack (3.5mm/RCA), and no other physical connector. Bluetooth 5.1 (A2DP, AVRCP, BLE for Google Fast Pair, HFP) is wireless-only, used for smartphone/tablet pairing (not a physical port so not listed). No USB signaling speed/version is published, so grade is omitted per rules. Product "type" enum has no exact "Speakerphone" category; "Speaker" was chosen as the closest fit for this audio-conferencing device (portable puck-style desktop speakerphone with 4-mic beamforming array + 50mm speaker). Not rack-mountable (120mm dia x 33mm H desktop puck, 280g), so rackUnits omitted. Two SKU variants exist (2755-109 MS Teams, 2755-209 UC) — both dark grey, identical physical I/O.

ports.name: USB
ports.note: Permanently integrated ~80cm cable terminating in a USB-C plug with an attached USB-A adapter (both connectors on one cable, not a combo jack on the device body). Used for both host connection (audio/call control) and charging; no USB version/speed is published by Jabra so no grade is set.
